I, 2ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>עוֹבְיוֹ של רקיע וכ׳</he> the thickness (diameter) of the heavens is equal to a journey of 500 years; <he>עוֹבְיָהּ של ארץ</he> the diameter of the earth; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 4">Gen. R. s. 4</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 94a:5">Pes. 94ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 42">Gen. R. s. 42</cite> <he>בעל קורה טעין בעוביה</he> the owner of the beam must put his shoulder to the thickest part of it; <cite ref="Berakhot 64a:6">Ber. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>בעָבְיָהּ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="K00021"><he>כַּאַן</he></cite>. Tanḥ. Sh’moth 3 <he>נותן עביה של תקרה זו בצד ראשה וכ׳</he> he places the thick side (trunk) of one beam by the side of the top (the thinner part) of the other beam; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1">Ex. R. s. 1</cite>. Ohol. XVI, 1 <he>בע׳ המרדע</he> measured by the diameter of the handle of a plough; <cite ref="Shabbat 17a:3">Sabb. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>מרדע שאמרו אין בעָבְיוֹ וכ׳</he> the handle of which they speak is less than a handbreadth in diameter, but is a handbreadth in circumference; a. e.
